Fontaine features many unique mechanics and environmental hazards:

### Arkhe[[](https://auth.fandom.com/signin?redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fgenshin-impact.fandom.com%2Fwiki%2FFontaine%3Fveaction%3Dedit%26section%3D20&uselang=en "Sign in to edit")]

Arkhe is composed of two opposing energy types: **[Ousia](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Ousia "Ousia")** and **[Pneuma](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Pneuma "Pneuma")**. When they meet, an annihilation reaction will be triggered. A character that possesses an Arkhe alignment can trigger a reaction by performing a Normal, Charged, or Plunging Attack on an object with the opposite alignment.

There are various ways that a character can gain an Arkhe alignment:

*   [Fontainian characters](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Category:Playable_Fontaine_Characters "Category:Playable Fontaine Characters") all have an innate Arkhe alignment.
*   [Furina](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Furina "Furina") can switch her Arkhe alignment by performing a Charged Attack.
*   The [Traveler](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Traveler "Traveler") has **[Pneuma](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Pneuma "Pneuma")** alignment while resonated with **[Hydro](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Hydro "Hydro")**.
*   The [Sword of Narzissenkreuz](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Sword_of_Narzissenkreuz "Sword of Narzissenkreuz") grants an Arkhe alignment while it is equipped. This alignment can be switched at the "Little Fountain" in [Annapausis](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Annapausis "Annapausis").
*   Characters can receive a temporary Arkhe alignment by picking up a [Pneumousia Block](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Pneumousia_Block "Pneumousia Block"). This temporary alignment expires after a short time, or when an Arkhe reaction is triggered.

Arkhe reactions can cause the following effects:

### Diving[[](https://auth.fandom.com/signin?redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fgenshin-impact.fandom.com%2Fwiki%2FFontaine%3Fveaction%3Dedit%26section%3D21&uselang=en "Sign in to edit")]

Unlocking the first [Statue of the Seven](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Statue_of_the_Seven "Statue of the Seven") in Fontaine grants the Diving ability. Rather than only being able to swim along the surface of the water, players can also dive and explore below the surface. This applies to all swimmable bodies of water in Fontaine except the sea around [Petrichor](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Petrichor "Petrichor").

*   While in any body of water which permits diving, the player will not consume [Stamina](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Stamina "Stamina") and cannot [drown](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Drowning "Drowning"). Fast swimming consumes Aquatic Stamina instead, and when it depletes the player must slow down, similar to how [sprinting](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Sprinting "Sprinting") works on land.
*   [Normal Attacks](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Normal_Attack "Normal Attack"), [Elemental Skills](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Elemental_Skill "Elemental Skill"), and [Elemental Bursts](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Elemental_Burst "Elemental Burst") are disabled while in the water. Instead, the player has a weak "water string" attack that does a small amount of damage to enemies. However, this attack can be used on [Xenochromatic Creatures](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Xenochromatic_Creature "Xenochromatic Creature") to acquire various abilities from them (see **Xenochromatic Abilities** below).
*   [Allogravity-Condensed Water Bodies](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Allogravity-Condensed_Water_Body "Allogravity-Condensed Water Body") are floating cubes of water found at the site of the [Fontaine Research Institute](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Fontaine_Research_Institute "Fontaine Research Institute") explosion. The player can dive inside them just like most other bodies of water in Fontaine. 
    *   The player receives an on-screen warning if they approach the side or bottom boundaries of the cube; continuing and crossing said boundary will cause the player to start falling.
    *   During the [World Quest](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/World_Quest "World Quest")_[Fontaine Research Institute, Stagnating in the Rubble](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Fontaine\_Research\_Institute,\_Stagnating\_in\_the\_Rubble "Fontaine Research Institute, Stagnating in the Rubble")_ in Series [Fontaine Research Institute Chronicles](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Fontaine_Research_Institute_Chronicles "Fontaine Research Institute Chronicles"), several of the cubes are contaminated by condensing components from the exploded Arkhium reactor. [These cubes](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/%22Allogravity-Condensed_Water_Body%22_affected_by_energy_flow "\"Allogravity-Condensed Water Body\" affected by energy flow") have a purple tint and the player diving inside them will continuously accumulate Turbulent Energy Flow until the condensing component is found and removed. Accumulating too much Turbulent Energy Flow causes all characters to [drown](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Fallen_Character "Fallen Character").

*   Entering a [Current](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Current "Current") will cause the player to move quickly along a pre-determined path, only able to control movement laterally within it.
*   Hidden underwater locations and objects can be revealed by touching an [Echoing Conch](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Echoing_Conch "Echoing Conch") or using the Sonar Waves Xenochromatic ability.
*   [Huge Shells](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Huge_Shell "Huge Shell") contain objects which are revealed when struck.
*   The player can recover [HP](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/HP "HP") by touching a [Recovery Orb](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Recovery_Orb "Recovery Orb").

### Energy Storage Devices[[](https://auth.fandom.com/signin?redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fgenshin-impact.fandom.com%2Fwiki%2FFontaine%3Fveaction%3Dedit%26section%3D22&uselang=en "Sign in to edit")]

Energy storage devices can be used to power machines.

*   The Fixed Storage Device is locked in place, while the Energy Transfer Device can be picked up and deployed near an object to be powered.
*   These devices are red when uncharged and blue/green when charged.
*   Some machines require power from a charged energy storage device to function: 
    *   Boxing Dummies _(unofficial name)_ must be attacked to trigger an effect.
    *   An [Energy Transfer Terminal](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Energy_Transfer_Terminal "Energy Transfer Terminal") can be used to extract energy from one device and transfer it to another. The player may need to switch to another terminal (by pointing at it with the viewfinder) to be able to see the target object. These terminals are also used to read [Cipher Letters](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Cipher_Letters "Cipher Letters") and occasionally operate other machines.
    *   [Stabilizers](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Stabilizer "Stabilizer") require the player to attack it while its indicator is within a blue zone three times to trigger an effect.

*   [Flying Energy Thieves](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Flying_Energy_Thief "Flying Energy Thief") are glowing balls found in the [Geode Mine Shaft](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Geode_Mine_Shaft "Geode Mine Shaft") that disable a storage device carried by the player.

### Symphony[[](https://auth.fandom.com/signin?redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fgenshin-impact.fandom.com%2Fwiki%2FFontaine%3Fveaction%3Dedit%26section%3D23&uselang=en "Sign in to edit")]

Available only in the [Nostoi Region](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Nostoi_Region "Nostoi Region"), Symphony is a game mechanic where the player can cause objects with musical note icons above them to stop or start moving.

*   [Mysterious Bookshelves](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/A_Mysterious_Bookshelf_Full_of_Grimoires "A Mysterious Bookshelf Full of Grimoires") are doorways in the [Faded Castle](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Faded_Castle "Faded Castle"). To open one, the player uses Symphony to halt a [Mysterious Grimoire](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Mysterious_Grimoire "Mysterious Grimoire"), capture it, deliver it to the Bookshelf, then use Symphony to move the books out of the way.
*   The [Ancient Autoharmonic Music Box](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Ancient_Autoharmonic_Music_Box "Ancient Autoharmonic Music Box") is powered by Symphony. The player can find scores and play them on the Music Box to unlock rewards and reveal the history of [Remuria](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Remuria "Remuria").
*   [Auric Anglerfish](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/The_Auric_Anglerfish! "The Auric Anglerfish!") are large mechanical fish, each of which holds a chest in its mouth. Using Symphony to pause one while near its tail will cause it to stop and hold its mouth open for a brief time, allowing the player to collect the chest.
*   [Autoharmonic Reed Pipes](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Autoharmonic_Reed_Pipes "Autoharmonic Reed Pipes") are devices which can be calibrated to one of three different notes with Symphony. They are always found in groups, and the puzzle is solved when all Reed Pipes at a location are set correctly.
*   The [Faded Castle](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Faded_Castle "Faded Castle") contains a stage that hosts a special challenge that will test the player's skills with Symphony.
*   [Scylla](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Scylla "Scylla") looks like a whale, but he is a powerful [Vishap](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Vishap "Vishap") that lives in the waters of the [Sea of Bygone Eras](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Sea_of_Bygone_Eras "Sea of Bygone Eras"). He is initially bound by Dragonborn-Suppressing Shackles, which the player must release by solving Symphony-based puzzles. Once he is free, Scylla is usually within sight of the player while swimming in the Sea, and tapping a button will cause the player to be rapidly drawn to him. While next to Scylla, the same action will allow the player to be quickly propelled in any direction away from him.
*   Certain special coral formations contain [Swaying Eels](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Swaying_Eels_in_the_Coral_Reefs "Swaying Eels in the Coral Reefs"); the player can interact with a formation to get the Eels to pop in and out. Use Symphony to pause them when they are all out to solve the puzzle.
*   [Washer Octopi](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Washer_Octopus "Washer Octopus") respond to Symphony, which can be used to manipulate them in various ways. [Resonant Anemones](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Resonant_Anemone "Resonant Anemone") light up when a Washer Octopus is nearby. Lighting up all the Anemones in a location simultaneously will trigger an effect.

### Xenochromatic Abilities[[](https://auth.fandom.com/signin?redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fgenshin-impact.fandom.com%2Fwiki%2FFontaine%3Fveaction%3Dedit%26section%3D24&uselang=en "Sign in to edit")]

Special abilities can be obtained from Xenochromatic Creatures found underwater. A button will appear which allows the player to use the ability; hold it down to aim it.

*   The [![Image 65: Armored Crab](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/gensin-impact/images/f/f1/Armored_Crab_Icon.png/revision/latest/scale-to-width-down/30?cb=20230816022721)](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Armored_Crab "Armored Crab")[![Image 66: Armored Crab](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/gensin-impact/images/f/f1/Armored_Crab_Icon.png/revision/latest/scale-to-width-down/30?cb=20230816022721)](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Armored_Crab "Armored Crab")[Armored Crab](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Armored_Crab "Armored Crab") ability grants a shield and the ability to fire damaging shockwaves. Absorbing an attack with the shield aiming will increase the shockwave damage. This is the only way to defeat [Bullet Barnacles](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Bullet_Barnacle "Bullet Barnacle"), and is useful for blocking [High-Pressure Water Vents](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/High-Pressure_Water_Vent "High-Pressure Water Vent") to position [Fantastical Floating Balls](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Fantastical_Floating_Ball "Fantastical Floating Ball") in their corresponding rings.
*   The [![Image 67: Ball Octopus](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/gensin-impact/images/6/64/Ball_Octopus_Icon.png/revision/latest/scale-to-width-down/30?cb=20230816022728)](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Ball_Octopus "Ball Octopus")[![Image 68: Ball Octopus](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/gensin-impact/images/6/64/Ball_Octopus_Icon.png/revision/latest/scale-to-width-down/30?cb=20230816022728)](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Ball_Octopus "Ball Octopus")[Ball Octopus](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Ball_Octopus "Ball Octopus") allows the player to fire an energy beam which can damage enemies and manipulate certain objects. Unlike the other abilities, it can also be obtained and used on land by interacting with certain ecological research devices. The ability is particularly useful for: 
    *   Destroying the floating objects over [Contaminated Bacterial Mats](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Contaminated_Bacterial_Mat "Contaminated Bacterial Mat") to remove them
    *   Moving or merging [Dew Bubbles](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Dew_Bubble "Dew Bubble"), used to trigger [Harmonious Reed Pipes](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Harmonious_Reed_Pipe "Harmonious Reed Pipe")
    *   Spinning [Floating Crystal Flowers](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Floating_Crystal_Flower "Floating Crystal Flower"), causing Floating Crystal Platforms to appear
    *   Moving [Humongous Hat Jellyfish](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Humongous_Hat_Jellyfish "Humongous Hat Jellyfish"), which can be used to launch the player into the air
    *   Manipulating [Operable Mechanisms](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Operable_Mechanism "Operable Mechanism") to commandeer [Dangerous Autocannons](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Dangerous_Autocannon "Dangerous Autocannon"), redirect Energy Flows, and solve other puzzles
    *   Launching [Potential Energy Orbs](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Potential_Energy_Orb "Potential Energy Orb") into their targets when standing within a nearby golden sign

*   The [![Image 69: Blubberbeast](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/gensin-impact/images/8/82/Blubberbeast_Icon.png/revision/latest/scale-to-width-down/30?cb=20230816022730)](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Blubberbeast "Blubberbeast")[![Image 70: Blubberbeast](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/gensin-impact/images/8/82/Blubberbeast_Icon.png/revision/latest/scale-to-width-down/30?cb=20230816022730)](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Blubberbeast "Blubberbeast")[Blubberbeast](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Blubberbeast "Blubberbeast") grants the ability to release waves of sonar that can detect significant objects as well as damage enemies.
*   The [![Image 71: Hunter's Ray](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/gensin-impact/images/2/2b/Hunter%27s_Ray_Icon.png/revision/latest/scale-to-width-down/30?cb=20230816022753)](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Hunter%27s_Ray "Hunter's Ray")[![Image 72: Hunter's Ray](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/gensin-impact/images/2/2b/Hunter%27s_Ray_Icon.png/revision/latest/scale-to-width-down/30?cb=20230816022753)](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Hunter%27s_Ray "Hunter's Ray")[Hunter's Ray](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Hunter%27s_Ray "Hunter's Ray") grants the ability to fire Fontemer Water Blades. As well as attacking enemies, it's also useful for cutting the glowing spots on [Fontemer Seagrass](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Fontemer_Seagrass "Fontemer Seagrass"). Cut all the spots within a short time to release whatever is trapped by the seagrass.
*   The [![Image 73: Hat Jellyfish](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/gensin-impact/images/1/10/Hat_Jellyfish_Icon.png/revision/latest/scale-to-width-down/30?cb=20230816022749)](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Hat_Jellyfish "Hat Jellyfish")[![Image 74: Hat Jellyfish](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/gensin-impact/images/1/10/Hat_Jellyfish_Icon.png/revision/latest/scale-to-width-down/30?cb=20230816022749)](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Hat_Jellyfish "Hat Jellyfish")[Hat Jellyfish](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Hat_Jellyfish "Hat Jellyfish") grants the ability to throw a Bing-Bang Hat Bomb and remotely detonate it. This ability is particularly useful for destroying underwater rock piles, [Red Meanies](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Red_Meanies "Red Meanies"), and [Strange Eels](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Strange_Eel "Strange Eel"). The latter two, when found in groups, must be all destroyed within moments of each other or they will respawn.

Screenshot from [Teyvat Chapter Storyline Preview: Travail](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Teyvat_Chapter_Storyline_Preview:_Travail "Teyvat Chapter Storyline Preview: Travail")

*   In the trailer _[Teyvat Chapter Storyline Preview: Travail](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Teyvat\_Chapter\_Storyline\_Preview:\_Travail "Teyvat Chapter Storyline Preview: Travail")_, under the title of the quest _[Masquerade of the Guilty](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Masquerade\_of\_the\_Guilty "Masquerade of the Guilty")_, there is a line written in Teyvat's [Latin script](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Latin-Based_Language "Latin-Based Language"). It reads "_Iustitia omnia vincit_" which roughly means "Justice conquers all," and is modified from the Latin phrase _[labor omnia vincit](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/labor\_omnia\_vincit "wikipedia:labor omnia vincit")_.
*   [Xingqiu](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Xingqiu "Xingqiu")'s novel, _[A Legend of Sword](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/A\_Legend\_of\_Sword "A Legend of Sword")_, is extremely popular in Fontaine and [Inazuma](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Inazuma "Inazuma").[[6]](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Fontaine#cite_note-7)
*   [Yanfei](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Yanfei "Yanfei"), in one of her Voice-Overs, notes that Fontaine's legal system is notoriously complicated.[[7]](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Fontaine#cite_note-8)
*   The [Kamera](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Kamera "Kamera") comes from Fontaine, as told by [Xu](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Xu "Xu") when giving the _[Snapshots](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Snapshots "Snapshots")_ World Quest.
*   [Midori](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Midori "Midori") claims that Fontaine has an "air-rail" system that allows citizens to travel along the sky, as [Ramsay](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Ramsay "Ramsay") wrote in his diary. However, there is no substantial evidence of this, and in the World Quest _[International Travel Log](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/International\_Travel\_Log "International Travel Log")_, the player finds out that most of what Ramsay writes in his diary is fictional.
*   Rock 'n' roll originates from Fontaine.[[8]](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Fontaine#cite_note-9)[[9]](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Fontaine#cite_note-10)
*   All [Oceanids](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Oceanid "Oceanid") are from Fontaine. They are loyal to the previous Hydro Archon, [Egeria](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Egeria "Egeria"), and allegedly left their native region because of the ideals of the new Hydro Archon, [Focalors](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Focalors "Focalors").
*   In Vol. 2 of _[Heart of Clear Springs](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Heart\_of\_Clear\_Springs "Heart of Clear Springs")_, Fontaine is described as "sapphire-blue."
*   Fontaine is currently the only nation that does not have any [One-Time Domains](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/One-Time_Domain "One-Time Domain").
*   After Focalors' execution by the [Oratrice Mecanique d'Analyse Cardinale](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Oratrice_Mecanique_d%27Analyse_Cardinale "Oratrice Mecanique d'Analyse Cardinale") and the destruction of the Hydro Archon's divine throne, Fontaine is currently the only region without an Archon, with the duties related to the Hydro Archon being instead passed to Neuvillette, the Hydro Dragon Sovereign. 
    *   This also makes Fontaine to be the first nation ruled by a Dragon Sovereign.

### Etymology[[](https://auth.fandom.com/signin?redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fgenshin-impact.fandom.com%2Fwiki%2FFontaine%3Fveaction%3Dedit%26section%3D28&uselang=en "Sign in to edit")]

*   _Fontaine_ means "fountain" in French, which is fitting for the home of the Hydro Archon.
*   The Chinese name for Fontaine, 枫丹/楓丹 _Fēngdān_, may be a clipping of "Fontainebleau" (枫丹白露/楓丹白露 _Fēngdānbáilù_), a commune in the metropolitan area of Paris known for its castle sitting right by the water.

### Cultural References[[](https://auth.fandom.com/signin?redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fgenshin-impact.fandom.com%2Fwiki%2FFontaine%3Fveaction%3Dedit%26section%3D29&uselang=en "Sign in to edit")]

*   Given the nation's technology, its emphasis on "true beauty and elegance," and the attire of its NPCs (e.g. [Caspar](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Caspar "Caspar")), Fontaine may be partially inspired by the [Belle Époque](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Belle_%C3%89poque "wikipedia:Belle Époque"), a period of French history in the late 19th century characterized by technological advancement and artistic flourishing. 
    *   Some of Fontaine's cultural elements seem to take inspiration from other cultures in and around France, such as [Basque](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Basques "wikipedia:Basques"), [Corsican](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Corsica "wikipedia:Corsica"), [Iberian](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Iberian_Peninsula "wikipedia:Iberian Peninsula") , [Italian](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Italy#Culture "wikipedia:Italy"), [Greek](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Greece#Culture "wikipedia:Greece"), [English](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Culture_of_England "wikipedia:Culture of England") cultures and [Western Europe](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Western_Europe "wikipedia:Western Europe") as a general.

*   Visually, Fontaine is inspired by the [Baroque](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Baroque "wikipedia:Baroque") and [Art Deco](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Art_Deco "wikipedia:Art Deco") styles, while its geography is in part based on that of the [French Alps](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/French_Alps "wikipedia:French Alps").[[10]](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Fontaine#cite_note-11)
*   Fontaine's theme as heard in the _[Teyvat Chapter Storyline Preview: Travail](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Teyvat\_Chapter\_Storyline\_Preview:\_Travail "Teyvat Chapter Storyline Preview: Travail")_ seems to be based on "Aquarium," the seventh movement of _[The Carnival of the Animals](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The\_Carnival\_of\_the\_Animals "wikipedia:The Carnival of the Animals")_, a musical suite by the French [Romantic](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Romanticism "wikipedia:Romanticism") composer [Camille Saint-Saëns](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Camille_Saint-Sa%C3%ABns "wikipedia:Camille Saint-Saëns").

Area
----

**Areas** are parts of the map in a particular [region](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Region "Region") and may be grouped into a [subregion](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Subregion "Subregion"). They are larger than [cities](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Cities "Cities") and individual [subareas](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Subareas "Subareas"), but smaller than entire regions.

Each area's part of the [map](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Map "Map") is unlocked upon activation of the corresponding [Statue of The Seven](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Statue_of_The_Seven "Statue of The Seven"), which also unlocks the [expedition](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Expedition "Expedition") locations for that area. Once unlocked, the map will provide information on the topography of the area, making it easier to find [Teleport Waypoints](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Teleport_Waypoints "Teleport Waypoints"), [Bosses](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Bosses "Bosses") and [Domains](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Domains "Domains").

[Exploration](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Exploration "Exploration") progress is tracked per area.

Lore

**Egeria and the Original Sin**
===============================
Legend has it that the first of oceans had a composition similar to that of blood, and that life within it was not individual. To set foot upon land or take to the skies, life evolved blood vessels to keep that primordial ocean flowing within itself. The beating heart that commanded this Primordial Sea of blood was the first Hydro Dragon. Each time that heart pulsed, all life would arise and give it praise.

When that first heart was removed, the envoy of Celestia, the leader upon whose shoulders lay the duty to create life, came to the great primeval sea, and there she created another heart, Egeria. That heart had like nobility unto a dragon, but lacked its outer form, and had the majesty of a god, yet was bereft of any divine duty. And though it was created by a ruler of humans, its substance and essence were all original matter from this world, entirely without outside elements. She was the tears that flowed into the primordial sea, seeking communication and understanding, a pursuit which caused her to weep. And it was due to this compassion that she committed all the sins that all beings of pure water must beware.

![Image 72: Scratched illustration depicts a large female character hovering over a man with outstretched arms, with a crowd of people standing near a body of water in the background](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/02/14/237301566/b0fb20592e699cd5342b9c87d6fab121_8080804659198869478.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

Egeria created the Oceanids (Lochfolks), elemental lifeforms. Oceanids, admiring the lives of humans, also wanted to become them. Egeria, using the power of the Primordial Sea, turned some Oceanids into humans whose blood flowed with the Primordial water. This creation of people became the original sin of Egeria. Celestia was angry with Egeria for stealing the power of the Sea, so they imprisoned her. A prophecy was created saying: _"In the end, the people will all be dissolved into the waters, and only the Hydro Archon will remain, weeping on her throne."_

![Image 79](https://wiki.hoyolab.com/m/genshin/entry/4780?lang=en-us)

**Egeria and Remuria**
======================
![Image 80: Artistic depiction of a grand structure with ornate detailing and glowing accents](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/04/29/237301566/4417194d9a22aa68cbc2c9d4aa037acd_7056164159267232608.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

While Egeria was imprisoned, Remus arrived in Fontaine and created Remuria. He was predicted to build a prosperous nation and bring civilization and justice to people, but in the end, that very justice would be their downfall. The God King could not abide the dark future foretold, and he decided to find Egeria, imprisoned in Fontemer. In the deepest depths of the waters, the abode of eternal night, the illustrious king learned all the secrets of the Mistress of Many Waters. Egeria told Remus that she had once committed an unforgivable sin, and the resulting curse was also irrevocable. In the end, Remus took the Pure Grail with him on the journey. He promised Egeria to create a world free from the shackles of providence.
In an attempt to escape fate, Remus created imperishable bodies of bronze and stone for his people with blood from insoluble Ichor so that time could not destroy them. The God King created a great Symphony so that every free person could control their own destinies. To bring civilization to the northern "barbarians," Remurian Harmosts led armies of golems to conquer the peoples of the High Sea, but Egeria's followers, the Lochknights, refused to submit. They swore to protect the spirits of pure springs (Oceanids) and other knights from the warriors of Remus. Their main goal was to find the Pure Grail to atone for the original sin and release Egeria from the shackles of confinement.

One legend says that when sin tempted the City of Eternity to its fall, the Lochknights faced unimaginable trials and endured sufferings never before known. But in the end, the heartfelt longing of the people reached the heavens. Then, thanks to their pure hearts and the Pure Grail obtained through countless sacrifices, the Mistress of Many Waters was freed from imprisonment and restored.

Another legend says that when sin tempted the City of Eternity to its fall, a singer named Erinnyes faced unimaginable trials and endured sufferings never before known. Yet, she remained unable to find that Pure Grail. But it was the heavens who chose the Mistress of Many Waters, commanding her to return from her primeval prison to take over from the golden king and rule the sea-ruins.

![Image 81: Woman in armor with a cup, with hanging stars in the background](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/02/14/237301566/996428185ebfa9cf6901d777752725de_2652658669534775645.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

Whatever the legend may be, when Egeria returned from captivity, she was awarded a shard of that one who was first, and gained both an Archon's right and the divine duty-come-lately. Thus began Egeria's reign as Hydro Archon of Fontaine. In honor of the Lochknights' feat, who witnessed the return of Egeria, the Fontinalia Festival was declared.

Previously, during the reign of Egeria, criminals were expelled to the desert, but some began to ask Egeria for forgiveness, and the merciful Mistress of Many Waters allowed them to guard the secret located in the sea. This is how the Fortress of Meropide came to be. This secret was a passage to the Primordial Sea, which, according to prophecy, was supposed to destroy Fontaine. Over time, the community of criminals grew, and many forgot about the original goal, but the passage to the Primordial Sea remained a forbidden zone.

![Image 94: Black and white circular symbol of three interlocked loops surrounding a small, central circle](https://wiki.hoyolab.com/_nuxt/img/genshin_avatar_bg.d444ebd.png)![Image 95: Blue gradient graphic of a cartoon piggy bank with a graduation hat on](https://wiki.hoyolab.com/_nuxt/img/avatar.7663739.png)

 Fragment of Harmonic Whimsy 

![Image 98](https://wiki.hoyolab.com/m/genshin/entry/4780?lang=en-us)

**Egeria and the Cataclysm**
============================
![Image 99: A forest, glowing in the blue light of a moonlit night, has large trees with thick trunks](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/02/14/237301566/06fb58047b7794f1c605ffa922279cd9_3967964877866276723.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

Millenia ago, Nabu Malikata, the Lord of Flowers, created a "daughter," Khvarena, whose fate was inevitable death and sacrifice. When Nabu Malikata sacrificed herself, she asked her friend, Rukkhadevata, to take care of Khvarena. The Mistress of Grass and Trees turned Khvarena into the divine bird Simurgh, charging her with the protection of two worlds, with the guardianship of the border between new birth and death. When the Cataclysm came many years later, the leader of the realm of water, Egeria, was slain in the Vourukasha Oasis in a battle with the Abyss monsters, and her body was transformed into a sea of pure dew, the Amrita. Then, the Amrita was desecrated by the Abyss, but the bird Simurgh fulfilled its duty by drinking from the Amrita and scattering into many pieces. As foretold, the daughter had to leave the embrace of the "three mothers," Rukkhadevata, Egeria, and Nabu Malikata, to sacrifice herself due to the growing impurity of the world. From these pieces, the Pari were born and protected the Vourukasha Oasis from the monsters of the Abyss.

![Image 100: Scene is from a video game and shows a large, glowing blue and purple lotus-like flower in a green forest, surrounded by grass and other foliage, with a path leading up to it](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/02/14/237301566/0058c3c9591f49bc0ac12760d5250fb4_7510331837180065839.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

Rukkhadevata grew the Harvisptokhm tree from the Amrita with the sacred lotus Gaokerena inside. The lotus contained the consciousness of Egeria, so she could hold back the barrier between the human world and the Abyss in the Tunigi Hollow.

![Image 101: Green lights emanate from the depths of a mountainous region with white flowering trees against a sunset](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/02/14/237301566/e53c4679115d76664383620ddb419cd7_198016762447992707.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

500 years later, the Gaokerena lotus became contaminated by the Abyss again. The barrier between the Abyss thinned, creating a phenomenon in the sky called the Sign of Apaosha. Thanks to the efforts of the Traveler, Paimon, the bloomguard Sorush, and other Pari, the Great Song of Khvarena was found and the Rite of Chinvat was performed to purify the Harvisptokhm.

**Egeria and Oceanids**
=======================
According to legend, the gentle Egeria shed the first tear, from which the first Oceanid was born. Some say that Egeria felt great sympathy for dragons, and others say she felt great sadness over the eventual fate of humanity. Now, all that we have left is a metaphorical representation whose true meaning remains unclear: _"The lizard's bones dissolved into mud, from which swans emerged."_ The newborn Oceanid was bestowed with the task of comprehending all forms of life: to seek an understanding of the diverse array of species and to love every creature. She emerged from the sea of life, possessing the power of metamorphosis. Egeria wished her to use this power to etch the essence of living creatures into her being and she gradually developed a yearning for life. Once it gained enough understanding of humanity, she shed its first tear upon the earth. Oceanids expressed love by merging water bodies together. This way, many minds could coexist without division.

The Oceanids were Egeria's familiars. She once sent them to live in rivers, streams, and ponds all over the continent, and almost all of them were spies for Fontaine. The Mistress of Many Waters wished to connect everyone in the world in much the same way as all water is connected.

Oceanids displayed considerable disparities in cognitive capacity, partially due to differences in lifespan resulting in very different levels of experience and knowledge regarding the world, but substantial individual variation in the Oceanids themselves also contributes to this phenomenon. Some Oceanids were simply too obtuse to complete tasks related to the continent's water systems and are thus confined to Fontaine, where they assist in soothing human emotions.

After the death of Egeria, many Oceanids lost contact with Fontaine. They did not recognize the new Hydro Archon and desired only to keep the dreams of yesteryear alive. Many Oceanids made pilgrimages across the sultry Sumeru Desert to reach Harvisptokhm and see their goddess.

![Image 117: Oceanid in Genshin Impact is a humanoid figure made of pure water, has glowing light, and has a fish-like tail](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/02/14/237301566/b1382ca8d5c39cd34c781837f05c5ea4_2796783750444812891.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

The powerful Oceanid Rhodeia, the most renowned of Lochfolk scouts, fled from Fontaine and settled near Qingce Village in Liyue, dreaming of a small haven of tranquil waters. When she met another Oceanid, Endora, she feared that she was an assassin from Fontaine, sent by Hydro Archon, and so she stretched forth her enmity, which turned the water bitter, in order to slay Endora. Having learned the truth, Rhodeia invited Endora to merge with her and make the waters sweet again, but Endora chose a different path.

![Image 118: A teal and white creature with wing-like appendages and a tail stands near a dark-haired person kneeling in front of a small campfire, on the shores of a lake, under a starry sky](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/02/14/237301566/824a0869fac4b8806047e7d2fb223c1e_5613481236590228235.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

The Oceanid, Callirhoe, known as the Spring Fairy, took up residence in the Springvale spring in Mondstadt. There, she met a boy who fell in love with her. Frightened by her feelings and afraid that many years later the boy would regret the time spent with the Oceanid, Callirhoe fell silent for many years.

_"When the stars in the night sky have all gone out, and all streams and dreams have mingled in the same great ocean... Then, we will meet again."_

Only when the boy grew up and became an old man did Callirhoe finally dare to meet him and respond to his feelings by giving her Heart of Clear Springs.

![Image 119: Oceanid Mimic, a blue and white elemental creature from Genshin Impact, holds a water-filled bottle charm](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/03/23/237301566/b8cbc99cb0b507eaf970fcd9568a5c43_1901413461255065258.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

Neither Rhodeia nor Callirhoe wanted Endora to follow their path, so Endora decided to take a path that no one else could take. She decided to go on a journey — to see everything from the flowers that bloom on its banks to the clouds that sit on the horizon.

![Image 120: The blue glowing spirit with a white collar, crown-like head, and fish-like tail floats in the air near a cliff](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/02/14/237301566/1db6cabb7224e998c529340769b5842a_4323134540389713668.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

Another powerful Oceanid, Idyia, having fled from Fontaine, met the witch Alice in the Sumeru desert, and she created for her a world in a bottle, Veluriyam Mirage. In this world, Idyia helped many lost and weary travelers, and when they left Veluriyam Mirage, she created their water projections from Hydro Eidolons so that they would continue to live in her world.

![Image 121: Anime-style image of five characters with steampunk-era clothing against a light blue and white background](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/02/14/237301566/9dd957087aa42735905d94761558de17_3840721841765083999.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

Oceanid Lyris, who did not have such high intellectual abilities as Rhodeia, Idyia, and Callirhoe, was put in charge of the Narzissenkreuz Institute, Fontaine's orphanage, even before the death of Egeria as a sign of her gratitude. It was in Lyris's orphanage that such prominent people for the history of Fontaine grew up as Basil Elton, admiral of the Fontaine navy; Alain Guillotin, the great scientist who solved the Fontaine energy crisis; and Rene de Petrichor and Jakob Ingold, who in their own way tried to resist Fontaine's prophecy and save all people.

**Egeria and Focalors**
=======================
![Image 153: A girl stands in front of Libra, the Scales](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/02/14/237301566/1da56616903c2c0ab282394bbb06bb8c_2762668338429049931.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

Focalors was once Egeria's Oceanid familiar. Focalors always wanted to become a human, since the very existence of a person in her eyes was the most beautiful performance. Egeria transformed Focalors into a human and later chose her as her successor to the Archon throne.

![Image 154: A figure wearing a crown and sitting on a throne is shown on a cracked beige background](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/02/14/237301566/4d00bf623c0adde66eacebeb7573b94e_1782249839317105255.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

Egeria knew for sure that the prophecy would come true, and that the heavenly principles could not be resisted. She placed the solution to this problem on the shoulders of Focalors. If the theft of the Primordial Sea's might was Fontaine's "original sin," the descent of Fontainians as humans and their right to exist in this world would be Fontaine's "original justice." "Existence" was Egeria's justice, and Focalors continued this principle. Defying the prophecy and ensuring that Fontaine's people shall live on — that should be the authority enthroned over all others.
Focalors pondered for a long time how to counter the prophecy and found the only possible answer: it was necessary to deceive the heavenly principles during the fulfillment of the prophecy. After becoming an Archon, Focalors separated her newfound divinity from her body and spirit, creating Furina. While Furina ruled Fontaine, Focalors accumulated energy to deceive the heavenly principles. 500 years later, when the prophecy began to come true, Focalors was able to use all this energy to destroy her divine part and, accordingly, destroy the throne of Hydro Archon, returning Hydro authority to the Dragon Sovereign Neuvillette. After gaining his full power, he forgave the Fontainians their original sin and turned them into real people.

**Egeria and the Original Sin**
===============================
Legend has it that the first of oceans had a composition similar to that of blood, and that life within it was not individual. To set foot upon land or take to the skies, life evolved blood vessels to keep that primordial ocean flowing within itself. The beating heart that commanded this Primordial Sea of blood was the first Hydro Dragon. Each time that heart pulsed, all life would arise and give it praise.

When that first heart was removed, the envoy of Celestia, the leader upon whose shoulders lay the duty to create life, came to the great primeval sea, and there she created another heart, Egeria. That heart had like nobility unto a dragon, but lacked its outer form, and had the majesty of a god, yet was bereft of any divine duty. And though it was created by a ruler of humans, its substance and essence were all original matter from this world, entirely without outside elements. She was the tears that flowed into the primordial sea, seeking communication and understanding, a pursuit which caused her to weep. And it was due to this compassion that she committed all the sins that all beings of pure water must beware.

![Image 187: Scratched illustration depicts a large female character hovering over a man with outstretched arms, with a crowd of people standing near a body of water in the background](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/02/14/237301566/b0fb20592e699cd5342b9c87d6fab121_8080804659198869478.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

Egeria created the Oceanids (Lochfolks), elemental lifeforms. Oceanids, admiring the lives of humans, also wanted to become them. Egeria, using the power of the Primordial Sea, turned some Oceanids into humans whose blood flowed with the Primordial water. This creation of people became the original sin of Egeria. Celestia was angry with Egeria for stealing the power of the Sea, so they imprisoned her. A prophecy was created saying: _"In the end, the people will all be dissolved into the waters, and only the Hydro Archon will remain, weeping on her throne."_

**Egeria and Remuria**
======================
![Image 195: Artistic depiction of a grand structure with ornate detailing and glowing accents](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/04/29/237301566/4417194d9a22aa68cbc2c9d4aa037acd_7056164159267232608.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

While Egeria was imprisoned, Remus arrived in Fontaine and created Remuria. He was predicted to build a prosperous nation and bring civilization and justice to people, but in the end, that very justice would be their downfall. The God King could not abide the dark future foretold, and he decided to find Egeria, imprisoned in Fontemer. In the deepest depths of the waters, the abode of eternal night, the illustrious king learned all the secrets of the Mistress of Many Waters. Egeria told Remus that she had once committed an unforgivable sin, and the resulting curse was also irrevocable. In the end, Remus took the Pure Grail with him on the journey. He promised Egeria to create a world free from the shackles of providence.
In an attempt to escape fate, Remus created imperishable bodies of bronze and stone for his people with blood from insoluble Ichor so that time could not destroy them. The God King created a great Symphony so that every free person could control their own destinies. To bring civilization to the northern "barbarians," Remurian Harmosts led armies of golems to conquer the peoples of the High Sea, but Egeria's followers, the Lochknights, refused to submit. They swore to protect the spirits of pure springs (Oceanids) and other knights from the warriors of Remus. Their main goal was to find the Pure Grail to atone for the original sin and release Egeria from the shackles of confinement.

One legend says that when sin tempted the City of Eternity to its fall, the Lochknights faced unimaginable trials and endured sufferings never before known. But in the end, the heartfelt longing of the people reached the heavens. Then, thanks to their pure hearts and the Pure Grail obtained through countless sacrifices, the Mistress of Many Waters was freed from imprisonment and restored.

Another legend says that when sin tempted the City of Eternity to its fall, a singer named Erinnyes faced unimaginable trials and endured sufferings never before known. Yet, she remained unable to find that Pure Grail. But it was the heavens who chose the Mistress of Many Waters, commanding her to return from her primeval prison to take over from the golden king and rule the sea-ruins.

![Image 196: Woman in armor with a cup, with hanging stars in the background](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/02/14/237301566/996428185ebfa9cf6901d777752725de_2652658669534775645.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

Whatever the legend may be, when Egeria returned from captivity, she was awarded a shard of that one who was first, and gained both an Archon's right and the divine duty-come-lately. Thus began Egeria's reign as Hydro Archon of Fontaine. In honor of the Lochknights' feat, who witnessed the return of Egeria, the Fontinalia Festival was declared.

Previously, during the reign of Egeria, criminals were expelled to the desert, but some began to ask Egeria for forgiveness, and the merciful Mistress of Many Waters allowed them to guard the secret located in the sea. This is how the Fortress of Meropide came to be. This secret was a passage to the Primordial Sea, which, according to prophecy, was supposed to destroy Fontaine. Over time, the community of criminals grew, and many forgot about the original goal, but the passage to the Primordial Sea remained a forbidden zone.

**Egeria and the Cataclysm**
============================
![Image 214: A forest, glowing in the blue light of a moonlit night, has large trees with thick trunks](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/02/14/237301566/06fb58047b7794f1c605ffa922279cd9_3967964877866276723.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

Millenia ago, Nabu Malikata, the Lord of Flowers, created a "daughter," Khvarena, whose fate was inevitable death and sacrifice. When Nabu Malikata sacrificed herself, she asked her friend, Rukkhadevata, to take care of Khvarena. The Mistress of Grass and Trees turned Khvarena into the divine bird Simurgh, charging her with the protection of two worlds, with the guardianship of the border between new birth and death. When the Cataclysm came many years later, the leader of the realm of water, Egeria, was slain in the Vourukasha Oasis in a battle with the Abyss monsters, and her body was transformed into a sea of pure dew, the Amrita. Then, the Amrita was desecrated by the Abyss, but the bird Simurgh fulfilled its duty by drinking from the Amrita and scattering into many pieces. As foretold, the daughter had to leave the embrace of the "three mothers," Rukkhadevata, Egeria, and Nabu Malikata, to sacrifice herself due to the growing impurity of the world. From these pieces, the Pari were born and protected the Vourukasha Oasis from the monsters of the Abyss.

![Image 215: Scene is from a video game and shows a large, glowing blue and purple lotus-like flower in a green forest, surrounded by grass and other foliage, with a path leading up to it](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/02/14/237301566/0058c3c9591f49bc0ac12760d5250fb4_7510331837180065839.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

Rukkhadevata grew the Harvisptokhm tree from the Amrita with the sacred lotus Gaokerena inside. The lotus contained the consciousness of Egeria, so she could hold back the barrier between the human world and the Abyss in the Tunigi Hollow.

![Image 216: Green lights emanate from the depths of a mountainous region with white flowering trees against a sunset](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/02/14/237301566/e53c4679115d76664383620ddb419cd7_198016762447992707.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

500 years later, the Gaokerena lotus became contaminated by the Abyss again. The barrier between the Abyss thinned, creating a phenomenon in the sky called the Sign of Apaosha. Thanks to the efforts of the Traveler, Paimon, the bloomguard Sorush, and other Pari, the Great Song of Khvarena was found and the Rite of Chinvat was performed to purify the Harvisptokhm.

**Egeria and Oceanids**
=======================
According to legend, the gentle Egeria shed the first tear, from which the first Oceanid was born. Some say that Egeria felt great sympathy for dragons, and others say she felt great sadness over the eventual fate of humanity. Now, all that we have left is a metaphorical representation whose true meaning remains unclear: _"The lizard's bones dissolved into mud, from which swans emerged."_ The newborn Oceanid was bestowed with the task of comprehending all forms of life: to seek an understanding of the diverse array of species and to love every creature. She emerged from the sea of life, possessing the power of metamorphosis. Egeria wished her to use this power to etch the essence of living creatures into her being and she gradually developed a yearning for life. Once it gained enough understanding of humanity, she shed its first tear upon the earth. Oceanids expressed love by merging water bodies together. This way, many minds could coexist without division.

The Oceanids were Egeria's familiars. She once sent them to live in rivers, streams, and ponds all over the continent, and almost all of them were spies for Fontaine. The Mistress of Many Waters wished to connect everyone in the world in much the same way as all water is connected.

Oceanids displayed considerable disparities in cognitive capacity, partially due to differences in lifespan resulting in very different levels of experience and knowledge regarding the world, but substantial individual variation in the Oceanids themselves also contributes to this phenomenon. Some Oceanids were simply too obtuse to complete tasks related to the continent's water systems and are thus confined to Fontaine, where they assist in soothing human emotions.

After the death of Egeria, many Oceanids lost contact with Fontaine. They did not recognize the new Hydro Archon and desired only to keep the dreams of yesteryear alive. Many Oceanids made pilgrimages across the sultry Sumeru Desert to reach Harvisptokhm and see their goddess.

![Image 232: Oceanid in Genshin Impact is a humanoid figure made of pure water, has glowing light, and has a fish-like tail](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/02/14/237301566/b1382ca8d5c39cd34c781837f05c5ea4_2796783750444812891.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

The powerful Oceanid Rhodeia, the most renowned of Lochfolk scouts, fled from Fontaine and settled near Qingce Village in Liyue, dreaming of a small haven of tranquil waters. When she met another Oceanid, Endora, she feared that she was an assassin from Fontaine, sent by Hydro Archon, and so she stretched forth her enmity, which turned the water bitter, in order to slay Endora. Having learned the truth, Rhodeia invited Endora to merge with her and make the waters sweet again, but Endora chose a different path.

![Image 233: A teal and white creature with wing-like appendages and a tail stands near a dark-haired person kneeling in front of a small campfire, on the shores of a lake, under a starry sky](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/02/14/237301566/824a0869fac4b8806047e7d2fb223c1e_5613481236590228235.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

The Oceanid, Callirhoe, known as the Spring Fairy, took up residence in the Springvale spring in Mondstadt. There, she met a boy who fell in love with her. Frightened by her feelings and afraid that many years later the boy would regret the time spent with the Oceanid, Callirhoe fell silent for many years.

_"When the stars in the night sky have all gone out, and all streams and dreams have mingled in the same great ocean... Then, we will meet again."_

Only when the boy grew up and became an old man did Callirhoe finally dare to meet him and respond to his feelings by giving her Heart of Clear Springs.

![Image 234: Oceanid Mimic, a blue and white elemental creature from Genshin Impact, holds a water-filled bottle charm](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/03/23/237301566/b8cbc99cb0b507eaf970fcd9568a5c43_1901413461255065258.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

Neither Rhodeia nor Callirhoe wanted Endora to follow their path, so Endora decided to take a path that no one else could take. She decided to go on a journey — to see everything from the flowers that bloom on its banks to the clouds that sit on the horizon.

![Image 235: The blue glowing spirit with a white collar, crown-like head, and fish-like tail floats in the air near a cliff](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/02/14/237301566/1db6cabb7224e998c529340769b5842a_4323134540389713668.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

Another powerful Oceanid, Idyia, having fled from Fontaine, met the witch Alice in the Sumeru desert, and she created for her a world in a bottle, Veluriyam Mirage. In this world, Idyia helped many lost and weary travelers, and when they left Veluriyam Mirage, she created their water projections from Hydro Eidolons so that they would continue to live in her world.

![Image 236: Anime-style image of five characters with steampunk-era clothing against a light blue and white background](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/02/14/237301566/9dd957087aa42735905d94761558de17_3840721841765083999.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

Oceanid Lyris, who did not have such high intellectual abilities as Rhodeia, Idyia, and Callirhoe, was put in charge of the Narzissenkreuz Institute, Fontaine's orphanage, even before the death of Egeria as a sign of her gratitude. It was in Lyris's orphanage that such prominent people for the history of Fontaine grew up as Basil Elton, admiral of the Fontaine navy; Alain Guillotin, the great scientist who solved the Fontaine energy crisis; and Rene de Petrichor and Jakob Ingold, who in their own way tried to resist Fontaine's prophecy and save all people.

**Egeria and Focalors**
=======================
![Image 268: A girl stands in front of Libra, the Scales](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/02/14/237301566/1da56616903c2c0ab282394bbb06bb8c_2762668338429049931.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

Focalors was once Egeria's Oceanid familiar. Focalors always wanted to become a human, since the very existence of a person in her eyes was the most beautiful performance. Egeria transformed Focalors into a human and later chose her as her successor to the Archon throne.

![Image 269: A figure wearing a crown and sitting on a throne is shown on a cracked beige background](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/02/14/237301566/4d00bf623c0adde66eacebeb7573b94e_1782249839317105255.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

Egeria knew for sure that the prophecy would come true, and that the heavenly principles could not be resisted. She placed the solution to this problem on the shoulders of Focalors. If the theft of the Primordial Sea's might was Fontaine's "original sin," the descent of Fontainians as humans and their right to exist in this world would be Fontaine's "original justice." "Existence" was Egeria's justice, and Focalors continued this principle. Defying the prophecy and ensuring that Fontaine's people shall live on — that should be the authority enthroned over all others.
Focalors pondered for a long time how to counter the prophecy and found the only possible answer: it was necessary to deceive the heavenly principles during the fulfillment of the prophecy. After becoming an Archon, Focalors separated her newfound divinity from her body and spirit, creating Furina. While Furina ruled Fontaine, Focalors accumulated energy to deceive the heavenly principles. 500 years later, when the prophecy began to come true, Focalors was able to use all this energy to destroy her divine part and, accordingly, destroy the throne of Hydro Archon, returning Hydro authority to the Dragon Sovereign Neuvillette. After gaining his full power, he forgave the Fontainians their original sin and turned them into real people.

Constellation

![Image 82: Blue illustration of a hillside with trees, a sun, and a blob-shaped creature](https://wiki.hoyolab.com/_nuxt/img/load_img.4e0fbb8.png)

Venerable Institution

When Neuvillette takes the field, he will obtain 1 stack of Past Draconic Glories from the Passive Talent "Heir to the Ancient Sea's Authority." You must first unlock the Passive Talent "Heir to the Ancient Sea's Authority."

Additionally, his interruption resistance will be increased while using the Charged Attack Empowerment: Legal Evaluation and the Charged Attack: Equitable Judgment.

![Image 83: Blue illustration of a hillside with trees, a sun, and a blob-shaped creature](https://wiki.hoyolab.com/_nuxt/img/load_img.4e0fbb8.png)

Juridical Exhortation

The Passive Talent "Heir to the Ancient Sea's Authority" will be enhanced: Each stack of Past Draconic Glories will increase the CRIT DMG of Charged Attack: Equitable Judgment by 14%. The maximum increase that can be achieved this way is 42%.

You must first unlock the Passive Talent "Heir to the Ancient Sea's Authority."

![Image 84: Blue illustration of a hillside with trees, a sun, and a blob-shaped creature](https://wiki.hoyolab.com/_nuxt/img/load_img.4e0fbb8.png)

Ancient Postulation

Increases the Level of Normal Attack: As Water Seeks Equilibrium by 3.

Maximum upgrade level is 15.

![Image 85: Blue illustration of a hillside with trees, a sun, and a blob-shaped creature](https://wiki.hoyolab.com/_nuxt/img/load_img.4e0fbb8.png)

Crown of Commiseration

When Neuvillette is on the field and is healed, 1 Sourcewater Droplet will be generated. This effect can occur once every 4s.

![Image 86: Blue illustration of a hillside with trees, a sun, and a blob-shaped creature](https://wiki.hoyolab.com/_nuxt/img/load_img.4e0fbb8.png)

Axiomatic Judgment

Increases the Level of O Tides, I Have Returned by 3.

Maximum upgrade level is 15.

![Image 87: Blue illustration of a hillside with trees, a sun, and a blob-shaped creature](https://wiki.hoyolab.com/_nuxt/img/load_img.4e0fbb8.png)

Wrathful Recompense

When using Charged Attack: Equitable Judgment, Neuvillette can absorb nearby Sourcewater Droplets in an AoE. Each absorbed Droplet will increase the duration of Charged Attack: Equitable Judgment by 1s.

Additionally, when Equitable Judgment hits opponents, it will fire off 2 additional currents every 2s, each of which will deal 10% of Neuvillette's Max HP as Hydro DMG. DMG dealt this way will count as DMG dealt by Equitable Judgment.

Lore

**Character Introduction**
--------------------------

You wouldn't exactly describe the Iudex of Fontaine as "approachable." It's hard to say whether it's just in his nature, or because he has secrets to hide.

**Character Relationships**
---------------------------

![Image 91: Black and white circular symbol of three interlocked loops surrounding a small, central circle](https://wiki.hoyolab.com/_nuxt/img/genshin_avatar_bg.d444ebd.png)![Image 92: Blue gradient graphic of a cartoon piggy bank with a graduation hat on](https://wiki.hoyolab.com/_nuxt/img/avatar.7663739.png)

Wriothesley
### **Voice-Overs**

**About Wriothesley**

Wriothesley is a trustworthy man. I fought hard for the title and reputation he now has. I expect you to think that I've simply been duped by his flattery and appearance of loyalty... But to that, I would quote the Inazuman proverb: "The words unspoken are the flower." Which means, some things are best left unsaid.

![Image 93: Black and white circular symbol of three interlocked loops surrounding a small, central circle](https://wiki.hoyolab.com/_nuxt/img/genshin_avatar_bg.d444ebd.png)![Image 94: Blue gradient graphic of a cartoon piggy bank with a graduation hat on](https://wiki.hoyolab.com/_nuxt/img/avatar.7663739.png)

Clorinde
### **Voice-Overs**

**About Clorinde**

Clorinde's peerless skills have made her the most powerful Champion Duelist in our nation. As a successor to the Marechaussee Hunters of old, she plays a vital role in ensuring the fairness and impartiality of the courtroom. Also, she's actually not as stoic as she might appear.

![Image 95: Black and white circular symbol of three interlocked loops surrounding a small, central circle](https://wiki.hoyolab.com/_nuxt/img/genshin_avatar_bg.d444ebd.png)![Image 96: Blue gradient graphic of a cartoon piggy bank with a graduation hat on](https://wiki.hoyolab.com/_nuxt/img/avatar.7663739.png)

Lyney
### **Voice-Overs**

**About Lyney and Lynette**

Their performances are just fascinating, don't you think? They draw you into a magical world where, on one hand, everything that takes place is part of an elaborate deception — but on the other, all manner of miracles are possible if you are only willing to believe.

**About Neuvillette**

Monsieur Neuvillette rarely appears in public, almost as if he's intentionally trying to put some distance between himself and the people. At first, I thought it might be just me, but my ever-observant sister noticed it too, so I suppose that must really be the case.

![Image 97: Black and white circular symbol of three interlocked loops surrounding a small, central circle](https://wiki.hoyolab.com/_nuxt/img/genshin_avatar_bg.d444ebd.png)![Image 98: Blue gradient graphic of a cartoon piggy bank with a graduation hat on](https://wiki.hoyolab.com/_nuxt/img/avatar.7663739.png)

Lynette
### **Voice-Overs**

**About Lyney and Lynette**

Their performances are just fascinating, don't you think? They draw you into a magical world where, on one hand, everything that takes place is part of an elaborate deception — but on the other, all manner of miracles are possible if you are only willing to believe.

**About Neuvillette**

The Chief Justice always feels strangely aloof, though his words are always humble... or perhaps he just doesn't like dealing with humans? After all, when he speaks with Melusines, he's actually quite friendly.

![Image 99: Black and white circular symbol of three interlocked loops surrounding a small, central circle](https://wiki.hoyolab.com/_nuxt/img/genshin_avatar_bg.d444ebd.png)![Image 100: Blue gradient graphic of a cartoon piggy bank with a graduation hat on](https://wiki.hoyolab.com/_nuxt/img/avatar.7663739.png)

Sigewinne
### **Voice-Overs**

**About Sigewinne**

I don't know how Sigewinne is faring these days. But if I hear so much as the whiff of a rumor that she's being bullied, I shall summon Wriothesley here and demand an explanation. She's so kind and vulnerable... She brought me some Kamera film the last time she visited, and asked to listen to more of my commentary on the water of Natlan... How long is it until her next vacation?

![Image 101: Black and white circular symbol of three interlocked loops surrounding a small, central circle](https://wiki.hoyolab.com/_nuxt/img/genshin_avatar_bg.d444ebd.png)![Image 102: Blue gradient graphic of a cartoon piggy bank with a graduation hat on](https://wiki.hoyolab.com/_nuxt/img/avatar.7663739.png)

Navia
### **Voice-Overs**

**About Navia**

I regret to say that after my various interactions with her — such as when I inadvertently angered her, and when I accepted her apology — and even now, in spite of the guilt I continue to feel over what happened to her father, I feel... very distant from her, as if I'm observing the starry sky from the bottom of a deep lake. It is by no means intentional, and I also know it is not something that I can easily make up for. Unlike water, emotion does not settle quickly once agitated, nor is it naturally inclined towards equilibrium.

![Image 103: Black and white circular symbol of three interlocked loops surrounding a small, central circle](https://wiki.hoyolab.com/_nuxt/img/genshin_avatar_bg.d444ebd.png)![Image 104: Blue gradient graphic of a cartoon piggy bank with a graduation hat on](https://wiki.hoyolab.com/_nuxt/img/avatar.7663739.png)

Freminet
### **Voice-Overs**

**About Neuvillette**

One day when I surfaced after a dive, the Chief Justice was just standing there alone on the beach. I don't know whether he had something on his mind, or was just enjoying the view... Obviously, I didn't ask. I only locked eyes with him for a split-second before disappearing back underwater. Thinking back, I must have looked so guilty... *sigh _*_

8.title: Fontaine Interactive Map and Location | Genshin Impact
8.description: Fontaine is the fifth map region ruled by the Hydro Archon in Genshin Impact. See its Interactive Map, how to get there, its puzzles, regional features, characters, quests, and all known info about it here!
8.content:
![Image 1: Genshin Impact - Fontaine Interactive Map and Location Guide](https://img.game8.co/3871118/4ee933c435e61cfb4f59cc30405e715d.png/show)

Fontaine is the fifth map region ruled by the Hydro Archon in Genshin Impact. See its Interactive Map, how to get there, its puzzles, regional features, characters, quests, and all known info about it here!

**Note**: You can toggle the Area drop down menu to see other Fontaine map areas!

What can you do as a free member?

![Image 4: Genshin - The Song of the Dragon and Freedom Archon Quest Guide](https://img.game8.co/3642646/93e1b6ce42b6c33f6349d0507d0e66a4.png/show)

The teleport waypoint by the Aquabus unlocks automatically once you've completed **The Song of the Dragon and Freedom**. It's the minimum requirement for unlocking Fontaine.

[The Song of the Dragon and Freedom Guide](https://game8.co/games/Genshin-Impact/archives/301808)

![Image 5: Genshin - How to Get to Fontaine](https://img.game8.co/3750751/bfa00c0b1b38524cdcb4ad186493b230.png/show)

After updating to Version 4.0, you can get to the city of Fontaine by **boarding the Aquabus** in Romaritime Harbor. The aquabus' closest teleport waypoint is located near the border of Fontaine and Sumeru, and should automatically unlock once you've finished [Prologue: Act 3](https://game8.co/games/Genshin-Impact/archives/301808).

![Image 6: Genshin - Romaritime Harbor Talk to Aeval](https://img.game8.co/3750345/913ee87662d3cd829226edced3b049b3.png/show)

Teleport to the waypoint in the middle of Fontaine and Sumeru, summon your [Waverider](https://game8.co/games/Genshin-Impact/archives/333642), and head to Romaritime Harbor. Ride the lift to the upper level and look for the aquabus.

Talking to the Aeval the [Melusine](https://game8.co/games/Genshin-Impact/archives/416594) will start your journey to Fontaine's main city!

![Image 7: Genshin - Romaritime Harbor Aquebus Waiting](https://img.game8.co/3750346/1f77b62b5de2efe0b627b9eeed79895a.png/show)

If your Aquabus is missing, just interact with the nearby bench and "wait for the aquabus". The Aquabus should come back after the loading screen!

| 4.6 Fontaine Locations |
| --- |
| ![Image 8: Genshin - Kingdom of Remuria Preview](https://img.game8.co/3869187/d50d0ded3ebeb230c5fac5d6616c7e8d.png/show) * * * [Nostoi Region](https://game8.co/games/Genshin-Impact/archives/451081) | ![Image 9: Genshin - Kingdom of Remuria Preview](https://img.game8.co/3868963/f677d2843e0d18c6681f117e9f9c0fe0.png/show) * * * [Sea of Bygone Eras](https://game8.co/games/Genshin-Impact/archives/451028) |

Nostoi Region and Sea of Bygone Eras were added to the Fontaine Map in [Version 4.6](https://game8.co/games/Genshin-Impact/archives/447404). Both are on the south side of Fontaine, where the historical town of [Petrichor](https://game8.co/games/Genshin-Impact/archives/451081) can be found, as well as the long-forgotten remains of the [Kingdom of Remuria](https://game8.co/games/Genshin-Impact/archives/451028) lie!

| 4.2 Fontaine Locations |
| --- |
| [![Image 10: Genshin - Erinnyes Forest](https://img.game8.co/3790082/904bbc95455db4c0996a0ed0ade280a4.png/show) * * * Erinnyes Forest](https://game8.co/games/Genshin-Impact/archives/431262) | [![Image 11: Genshin - Morte Region](https://img.game8.co/3790141/daac02586d0fb42938bda39d4c42989c.png/show) * * * Morte Region](https://game8.co/games/Genshin-Impact/archives/431876) |

The Erinnyes Forest and Morte Region were added in [Version 4.2](https://game8.co/games/Genshin-Impact/archives/427825)! Both regions are part of the world quests, [The Wild Fairy of Erinnyes](https://game8.co/games/Genshin-Impact/archives/432141), and the [Search in Algae Sea](https://game8.co/games/Genshin-Impact/archives/432206)!

| 4.1 Fontaine Locations |
| --- |
| [![Image 12: Genshin - Fortress of Meropide 2](https://img.game8.co/3765082/88f3fbca97ded1faed48f973f3918f85.png/show) * * * Fortress of Meropide](https://game8.co/games/Genshin-Impact/archives/426290) | [![Image 13: Genshin - Old Fontaine Research Institute](https://img.game8.co/3765163/10cbf224de637c72153c6853f6b420c7.png/show) * * * Fontaine Research Institute](https://game8.co/games/Genshin-Impact/archives/428380) |

New regions have recently been added to Fontaine. This area is located north of the present Court of Fontaine region, and it features the Old Fontaine Research Institute as well as the Fortress of Meropide, which can be found in the Liffey Region.

![Image 14: Genshin - Allogravity Condensed Water Bodies 3](https://img.game8.co/3765142/ea5354a27cecabd778b476a16891be6b.png/show)

The old Fontaine Research Institute makes it appearance in Version 4.1, alluding the catastrophe that the insitute experienced because of a failed experiment. The ruins are now composed of Allogravity-Condensed Water Bodies as a result.

[Fontaine Research Institute Guide](https://game8.co/games/Genshin-Impact/archives/426297)

![Image 15: Genshin - Meropide Showcase](https://img.game8.co/3765162/71f8d6d114dc1368f6f5486f7dacc65c.png/show)

The underwater Fortress of Meropide featured in the [Archon Quest Chapter 4 Act 2](https://game8.co/games/Genshin-Impact/archives/420285) quest is also unlocked in Version 4.1! You can reach the Fortress by getting inside on your own to trigger [Unfinished Comedy](https://game8.co/games/Genshin-Impact/archives/428383), or you can progress thru Act 3 of the Archon Quest!

[Fortress of Meropide Guide](https://game8.co/games/Genshin-Impact/archives/426290)

| 4.2 Surface Map | 4.6 Nostoi Region |
| --- | --- |
| ![Image 16: Genshin - 4.2 Fontaine Map](https://img.game8.co/3792068/34b0cf027c21865cd912bdf94dc0c46d.png/show) * * * [See full image in new tab](https://img.game8.co/3792068/34b0cf027c21865cd912bdf94dc0c46d.png/original) | ![Image 17: Genshin - Nostoi Region](https://img.game8.co/3873195/395b4e014b3629a16b7c2a3833221a7d.png/show) * * * [See full image in new tab](https://img.game8.co/3873194/86a2911fdae50d771ad0cc9667224c27.png/original) |

Fontaine is located northeast of the **Hills of Barsom** in the [Sumeru Desert](https://game8.co/games/Genshin-Impact/archives/383491). You will need to use a Waverider to reach the Romaritime Harbor where you can find an Aquabus to the Court of Fontaine.

At the time of writing, the Fontaine map is updated as of [Version 4.6](https://game8.co/games/Genshin-Impact/archives/447404).

With the [new diving mechanic](https://game8.co/games/Genshin-Impact/archives/416599) in Version 4.0, players can explore Fontaine's underwater landscapes. This underwater map has been updated for [Version 4.6](https://game8.co/games/Genshin-Impact/archives/447404)!

[Fontaine Underwater Map Guide](https://game8.co/games/Genshin-Impact/archives/421022)

Because of Fontaine's Blessing, [Transoceanic Sourcewater](https://game8.co/games/Genshin-Impact/archives/421685), you can explore the underwater areas of Fontaine through the Diving Mechanic!

Other than allowing you to dive into Fontaine's waters, this blessing also allows you to gain the abilities of [Xenochromatic Creatures](https://game8.co/games/Genshin-Impact/archives/421478)!

[Diving Mechanic in Fontaine](https://game8.co/games/Genshin-Impact/archives/416599)

![Image 21: Genshin - Fontaine](https://img.game8.co/3746021/95b83f661b4dd510d85ba217a9a759b2.png/show)

Pneumosia Energy is comprised of both Pneuma and Ousia—two opposing energies utilized by residents of Fontaine as a source of sustainable energy called **Indemnitium**, to power up the nation, and all the Clockwork Meka!

Fusing these two energies together creates a **Balanced** energy that activates certain mechanisms in Fontaine—or "Annihilate" machine beings.

[What are Pneuma and Ousia?](https://game8.co/games/Genshin-Impact/archives/298253)

![Image 22: Genshin - Fontaine](https://img.game8.co/3746023/25d4d4e57e6a058850ce55064dd44265.png/show)

The Arkhe System refers to the inherent Pneumosia alignment of characters from Fontaine. This can help them interact with the Pneumosia Energy all over Fontaine and is separate from each Fontainian character's Vision!

| Clockwork Meka Previews |
| --- |
| ![Image 23: Genshin - Clockwork Meka 1](https://img.game8.co/3746100/1f76f958255017f87e6ae48d6b5e2d2d.png/show) | ![Image 24: Genshin - Clockwork Meka 2](https://img.game8.co/3746101/ff4448428439b41ad0beeb6f1cda975f.png/show) |

Clockwork Meka are machine beings that are primarily powered by Pneuma-Ousia Annihilation Reaction energy blocks invented by Alain Guillotin, founder of the Fontaine Research Institute.

These machine beings perform a number of functions, such as patrolling, defense, underwater exploration, among others. Be careful though, as not all Clockwork Meka are friendly!

Clockwork Mekas can still function even outside Fontaine, but can only do so through pre-prepared energy blocks that contain Pneumosia Energy!

[Clockwork Meka Enemy Guide](https://game8.co/games/Genshin-Impact/archives/420292)

![Image 25: Genshin - Melusine](https://img.game8.co/3746103/ae23f73dfbb6ab30a3e6c9d9be254cb6.png/show)

Melusines are a race of beings characterized by their long and protruding ears, and whose place of residence is primarily in Beryl Region.

From the[Ancient Colors](https://game8.co/games/Genshin-Impact/archives/421870) World Quest, it was also revealed that their progenitor is Elynas, a felled-dragon whose blood had polluted the rivers of Fontaine for years!

[Who are the Melusines?](https://game8.co/games/Genshin-Impact/archives/416594)

![Image 26: Genshin - Fountain of Lucine](https://img.game8.co/3750693/d5d12535cc180657d604f5ed06a31872.png/show)

The Fountain of Lucine serves as the reward system in Fontaine where you can exchange collected [Hydro Sigils](https://game8.co/games/Genshin-Impact/archives/421936) with valuable items!

This system can be unlocked as soon as you reach Fontaine, but we recommend progressing through the region's [Archon Quest: Act 1](https://game8.co/games/Genshin-Impact/archives/420282) for a better experience as it will point you to the fountain's location!

[How to Unlock Fountain of Lucine](https://game8.co/games/Genshin-Impact/archives/421828)

![Image 27: Genshin - Fontaine Aquabus](https://img.game8.co/3751302/88c2271462efb5c3dfb1de9e2e37f4ee.png/show)

Aquabuses are vehicles that you use to traverse the waterways that connect the Court of Fontaine and to other areas such as the Romaritime Harbor, Fountain of Lucine, and Opera Eclese.

[Fontaine Aquabus Guide](https://game8.co/games/Genshin-Impact/archives/421981)

19.title: エゲリア - 原神 - HoYoWiki
19.description: HoYoWiki - 原神 - エゲリア: フォンテーヌの初代水神。{shady:眷属である純水精霊の願いを叶えようとし原始胎海の力を使って疑似的人類を作り出す。}
19.content:
**エゲリアと原罪**
-----------

伝説では、原初の海の成分は血液に似ていて、生命はそこに浸ると溶けてしまうという。海にあった生命が、陸と空に立ち入るために、血管を進化させて原初の海を体内に留めようとした。この原初の海、すなわち血の海を支配した心臓とも言える存在が原初の水の龍である。心臓の鼓動が聞こえるたび、あらゆる生き物が繰り返し立ち上がり、そして跪くという。

その心臓が取り除かれた後、天空の島の使者であり聖霊を創造する使命を背負った統率者は、原初の海に別の心臓を創り出した。その心臓こそがエゲリアだと考えられる。龍の如き気高さがありながら見た目は龍にあらず、神の如き威厳を纏いながら神聖な使命を持たない。素材と性質はテイワットに由来し、外来の要素が一つもない。

エゲリアは交流と理解を追求し、それ故に涙を流す。この交流と理解、まさに慈悲の心こそが「原罪」を犯すに至った原因だ。

![Image 1: Drawing on a cracked wall of a woman with hands pointing to a man inside of a circle, a line of people walking towards the water, and drawings of creatures with wings](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/04/30/169033420/b0fb20592e699cd5342b9c87d6fab121_8010389655266194324.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

エゲリアは元素生物である

![Image 2: Black and white circular symbol of three interlocked loops surrounding a small, central circle](https://wiki.hoyolab.com/_nuxt/img/genshin_avatar_bg.d444ebd.png)![Image 3: Blue gradient graphic of a cartoon piggy bank with a graduation hat on](https://wiki.hoyolab.com/_nuxt/img/avatar.7663739.png)

純水精霊

を創造した。純水精霊は人間の生き方に憧れ、人間になりたいと願うようになる。エゲリアは原初の海の力を利用して、純水精霊を原初の水の血が流れる疑似的人類に変えた。この人間の創造がエゲリアの原罪である。原初の海の力を盗んだエゲリアは天理から怒りを買い、以下の予言が作られた。

_人々はみな海の中に溶け、水神は自らの神座で涙を流す。そうして初めて、フォンテーヌ人の罪は洗い流される。_

また、エゲリアは後述のレムリア文明が滅ぶまで深き海の底に幽閉された。

レムリア

を建国した。レムリアは予言者シビラによって「豊かな国を築き、人々に文明と正義をもたらすが最終的にはその正義によって破滅する」と予言された。レムスはこの無明の未来を回避すべく囚われのエゲリアを捜した。深き海の底、永夜の幽邃なる住まいでエゲリアを見つけ、レムスはそこで恐ろしい秘密をすべて知ることになる。エゲリアはレムスに、自分はかつて許されざる大罪を犯し、その呪いも取り返しのつかないものだと語った。回避の策もエゲリアから得られなかったが、それでも野心と希望を胸に抱いたレムスは、海の底を離れる前に純潔の水を一杯持ちだした。
この運命から逃れるため、レムスは民の魂を水に溶けないイコルに封じ込め、精銅と磐石で不滅の肉体を作った。レムスはすべての人々が自らの運命をコントロールできるように、調和と繁栄の楽章を作曲した。「蛮族」(レムリア人はフォンテーヌ人を蛮族と呼称していた)に文明をもたらすために、レムリアの調律師達は魔像の軍団を率いて高海を征服したが、エゲリアの信奉者である

ある伝説によると、深き罪が永遠の都に没落をもたらしたとき、エリニュスという名の騎士は想像を絶するほど多くの試錬と、世にも稀な困難を幾多も乗り越え、ついに人々の最も誠実な願いを高天に伝えたという。そして、無数の犠牲を経て得た純水の杯により、最終的にエゲリアは古の幽閉から解き放たれたという。

別の伝説によれば、深き罪が永遠の都に没落をもたらしたとき、エリニュスという名の歌い手は想像を絶するほど多くの試錬と、世にも稀な苦難を幾多も乗り越えたが、いまだに純水の杯を見つけ出せずにいるという。ちょうどそのとき、天理はエゲリアを古の幽閉から呼び戻し、レムスの座を引き継いでフォンテーヌを統べるよう命じたという。
