伝説によると、

![Image 47: Black and white circular symbol of three interlocked loops surrounding a small, central circle](https://wiki.hoyolab.com/_nuxt/img/genshin_avatar_bg.d444ebd.png)![Image 48: Blue gradient graphic of a cartoon piggy bank with a graduation hat on](https://wiki.hoyolab.com/_nuxt/img/avatar.7663739.png)

純水精霊

は慈愛に満ちたエゲリアが最初に流した一滴の涙から誕生したという。その涙は、龍たちを憐れんだからとも、人類を待ち受ける運命を悲しんだからともいわれている。生まれたばかりの純水精霊には万物の理解という使命が与えられる。森羅万象を知り、あらゆる命を愛せよという使命だ。生命の海から生まれた純水精霊は、生物に変身する能力を持つ。エゲリアは純水精霊に生物の形を記憶させた。その結果、純水精霊は徐々に生命への憧憬を抱いていった。人類を十分に理解したとき、純水精霊は大地に初めての涙をこぼす。そうして始祖やその血統は「彼女」と呼ばれるようになる。これが純水精霊の起源と言われている。
純水精霊はエゲリアの眷属だった。かつて、純水精霊は大陸中の川や渓谷の水にフォンテーヌのスパイとして送り出された。エゲリアはただ水を通して、大陸中の皆を繋ぐことを望んでいた。

純水精霊の知能は上下に大きなばらつきがある。寿命の違いによる知見や見聞の差、著しい個体差がその一因と考えられている。中にはあまりにも愚かなために大陸の水系に関わる任務には不向きと判断され、フォンテーヌに留まり人類を癒す役目しか果たせぬ者もいる。

エゲリアの没後、多くの純水精霊がフォンテーヌから離れる。新たな水神を認めず、かつての夢を抱くしかなかった。また、多くの純水精霊がエゲリアの死地である万種母樹を目指し、スメールを巡礼した。

水仙十字結社

**エゲリアとフォカロルス**
---------------

![Image 82: Black and white circular symbol of three interlocked loops surrounding a small, central circle](https://wiki.hoyolab.com/_nuxt/img/genshin_avatar_bg.d444ebd.png)![Image 83: Blue gradient graphic of a cartoon piggy bank with a graduation hat on](https://wiki.hoyolab.com/_nuxt/img/avatar.7663739.png)

フォカロルス

はエゲリアの

![Image 84: Black and white circular symbol of three interlocked loops surrounding a small, central circle](https://wiki.hoyolab.com/_nuxt/img/genshin_avatar_bg.d444ebd.png)![Image 85: Blue gradient graphic of a cartoon piggy bank with a graduation hat on](https://wiki.hoyolab.com/_nuxt/img/avatar.7663739.png)

純水精霊

の眷属の一人だった。フォカロルスにとって人間になることは夢だった。人間の存在そのものが、美しい歌劇のようなものだと考えていたためだ。エゲリアはフォカロルスを人間に変え、水神の後継者に選んだ。

![Image 86: A drawing of a cartoon character sitting on a throne in front of a city](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/04/30/169033420/4d00bf623c0adde66eacebeb7573b94e_3186256758447880035.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

エゲリアは予言が実現すること、そして運命に逆らえないことを確信していた。この問題の解決策をフォカロルスに託す。原初の海の力を奪ったことがフォンテーヌの「原罪」ならば、フォンテーヌ人が人として生まれ、この世に存在する資格こそが、フォンテーヌの「原初の正義」だ。「存在」がエゲリアの正義であり、フォカロルスは正義を「存続」と捉えた。つまり、予言を打ち破り、フォンテーヌの人々を生かすこと。彼女はそれこそがすべてを超える正義であるべきだと考えた。
フォカロルスは予言に対抗する方法を長い時間考え、唯一の答えを見つける。「天理」を欺くことのみが、予言が起こると同時に、フォンテーヌ人を救える唯一の方法だと考えた。神となってすぐフォカロルスは自らの神格を分離し、残った人間の体を

![Image 87: Black and white circular symbol of three interlocked loops surrounding a small, central circle](https://wiki.hoyolab.com/_nuxt/img/genshin_avatar_bg.d444ebd.png)![Image 88: Blue gradient graphic of a cartoon piggy bank with a graduation hat on](https://wiki.hoyolab.com/_nuxt/img/avatar.7663739.png)

フリーナ

と名付けた。フリーナがフォンテーヌを統治している間、神格としてのフォカロルスは諭示機に律償混合エネルギーを蓄積した。500年が経過し、予言が現実になり始めたとき、フォカロルスは全てのエネルギーを使って水神の神座を破壊した。その結果、水神としての権能は水の元素龍であるヌヴィレットの元に戻った。

![Image 89: Black and white circular symbol of three interlocked loops surrounding a small, central circle](https://wiki.hoyolab.com/_nuxt/img/genshin_avatar_bg.d444ebd.png)![Image 90: Blue gradient graphic of a cartoon piggy bank with a graduation hat on](https://wiki.hoyolab.com/_nuxt/img/avatar.7663739.png)

ヌヴィレット

は龍王として完全な力を手に入れ、フォンテーヌ人の原罪を許し、彼らを「真の人類」に変えた。

Properties

### **Relationships**

![Image 2: Black and white circular symbol of three interlocked loops surrounding a small, central circle](https://wiki.hoyolab.com/_nuxt/img/genshin_avatar_bg.d444ebd.png)![Image 3: Blue gradient graphic of a cartoon piggy bank with a graduation hat on](https://wiki.hoyolab.com/_nuxt/img/avatar.7663739.png)

Egeria The previous Hydro Archon who created Focalors and gave her a human body.
![Image 4: Black and white circular symbol of three interlocked loops surrounding a small, central circle](https://wiki.hoyolab.com/_nuxt/img/genshin_avatar_bg.d444ebd.png)![Image 5: Blue gradient graphic of a cartoon piggy bank with a graduation hat on](https://wiki.hoyolab.com/_nuxt/img/avatar.7663739.png)

Furina The body and spirit created by Focalors, with the calling to act her role of ruling Fontaine for 500 years..
![Image 6: Black and white circular symbol of three interlocked loops surrounding a small, central circle](https://wiki.hoyolab.com/_nuxt/img/genshin_avatar_bg.d444ebd.png)![Image 7: Blue gradient graphic of a cartoon piggy bank with a graduation hat on](https://wiki.hoyolab.com/_nuxt/img/avatar.7663739.png)

Oceanids An intelligent Hydro lifeform created by Egeria. Focalors was one of the Oceanids.
![Image 8: Black and white circular symbol of three interlocked loops surrounding a small, central circle](https://wiki.hoyolab.com/_nuxt/img/genshin_avatar_bg.d444ebd.png)![Image 9: Blue gradient graphic of a cartoon piggy bank with a graduation hat on](https://wiki.hoyolab.com/_nuxt/img/avatar.7663739.png)

Neuvillette The Dragon Sovereign and the Iudex of Fontaine.
Oratrice Mecanique d'Analyse Cardinale A special device designed by Focalors to accumulate Indemnitium and destroy the Hydro Divine throne.

Lore

![Image 10: Illustration on a wall in beige color depicting a person surrounded by others, hands and birds, with cracked paint](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/04/09/237301566/b0fb20592e699cd5342b9c87d6fab121_6327654859344677399.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

The heart of the Primordial Sea, Egeria, known as the Mistress of Many Waters, created the Oceanids, intelligent elemental lifeforms. Oceanids, admiring the lives of humans, also wanted to become them. The Mistress of Many Waters answered their wishes and, using the power of the Primordial Sea turned some Oceanids into humans whose blood flowed with the Primordial water. In doing so, she committed the original sin. Celestia was angry with the Mistress of Many Waters for stealing the power of the Sea, so they imprisoned her. A prophecy was created saying: _"In the end, the people will all be dissolved into the waters, and only the Hydro Archon will remain, weeping on her throne."_ The prophecy was carved into Irminsul long ago and couldn’t be avoided. Millennia ago, Egeria returned from captivity and gained both an Archon's right and the divine duty-come-lately.

![Image 11: Furina and the Scales of Justice as seen in a Genshin Impact character banner](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/04/09/237301566/6ec960ac7a2160449e946df38d1b5da0_691909026731103960.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

Focalors was once Egeria's Oceanid familiar. She always wanted to become a human, since the very existence of a person in her eyes was the most beautiful performance, so Egeria transformed Focalors into a human. 500 years ago, the Mistress of Many Waters died in the Cataclysm and chose Focalors as her successor to the Archon Throne. Egeria knew that the prophecy would come true and that the Heavenly Principles could not be resisted. She placed the solution to this problem on the shoulders of Focalors. If the theft of the Primordial Sea's might was Fontaine's "original sin," the descent of Fontainians as humans and their right to exist in this world would be Fontaine's "original justice." "Existence" was Egeria's justice, and Focalors continued this principle. Defying the prophecy and ensuring that Fontaine's people shall live on — that should be the authority enthroned over all others.
**Related Entries:**

![Image 12: Black and white circular symbol of three interlocked loops surrounding a small, central circle](https://wiki.hoyolab.com/_nuxt/img/genshin_avatar_bg.d444ebd.png)![Image 13: Blue gradient graphic of a cartoon piggy bank with a graduation hat on](https://wiki.hoyolab.com/_nuxt/img/avatar.7663739.png)

![Image 16: Black and white circular symbol of three interlocked loops surrounding a small, central circle](https://wiki.hoyolab.com/_nuxt/img/genshin_avatar_bg.d444ebd.png)![Image 17: Blue gradient graphic of a cartoon piggy bank with a graduation hat on](https://wiki.hoyolab.com/_nuxt/img/avatar.7663739.png)

Egeria

**Prophecy**
------------
![Image 18: Furina, a video game character, stands in front of the mirror and sees her reflection in the style of Fontaine](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/04/09/237301566/6b63ba3a7d5c46b0a07282251614a445_5914282810604832850.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

Focalors pondered for a long time how to counter the prophecy and found the only possible answer: it was necessary to deceive the Heavenly Principles during the fulfillment of the prophecy. After becoming an Archon, Focalors separated her newfound divinity from her body and spirit. The human counterpart she left behind, she named "Furina." Furina was just a human, but she could feel joy, sorrow, and everything in between; she could be as vain and conceited, or as meek and vulnerable as she wished; her strengths were of a kind only a human could possess, as were her shortcomings. In Focalors's eyes, 

![Image 19: Two anime characters look at each other in a game scene](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/04/09/237301566/7d385a6c1ba9e5d7ccb649d37c020ec0_8512935986327015719.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

Furina's humanity was what made her perfect, the person Focalors always wanted to be. After she made Furina, she also cursed her, so as long as Focalors's divinity continued to exist, Furina could not die to fulfill the prophecy. Furina was tasked to take the stage in the opera house, embrace the role of leading lady, and forever play the part of the god from the prophecy to create a deceitful appearance of that prophecy coming to pass. Focalors promised that her torture would eventually end in a magnificent and dramatic trial, and everyone would be saved. Furina didn't know when the final trial would be, so for all these 500 years she played her role, trying to solve the prophecy and save the people.

![Image 20: An artistic render of an interior area, with a set of scales in the center, each side containing blue water drops, set against a background of columns and decorative window](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/04/10/237301566/f9637e460d788f9ba3c8144200245850_5440911958406479077.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

While Furina ruled Fontaine, Focalors accumulated energy to deceive the Heavenly Principles. She created and placed her divinity along with the Hydro Gnosis in the Oratrice Mecanique d'Analyse Cardinale — a special device in the Opera Epiclese, where all trials were held. The Oratrice converted the people's faith in justice into Indemnitium, a type of energy that powers Fontaine. If this power, accrued over five centuries, has only been used to sustain Fontainians, it could have lasted for millennia, but it has its purpose. Along with the Chief Justice, this device passed sentences in court, and its sentence has always been crucial. Although it was used for trials, in truth its main purpose was to kill the God of Justice along with the Divine Throne when the time comes. Focalors understood that only power of this magnitude could hope to destroy the Hydro Archon's Divine Throne, shaking the rules established by Celestia and breaking through the institution that is The Seven.

![Image 21: Hydroculus, glowing in shades of pale cyan and blue, floating in front of a portal on the ceiling](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/04/09/237301566/e04b1145b19d9257af9cb3f66e5c8ffe_5112452436646273335.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

500 years later, when the prophecy began to come true and Focalors accumulated enough Indemnitium, the Oratrice Mecanique d'Analyse Cardinale sentenced the Hydro Archon to death. Focalors met with the Dragon Sovereign, Neuvillette, to entrust him with the decision upon the people of Fontaine. Neuvillette was invited to the Court of Fontaine to serve as Iudex as a part of Focalors's plan, and she knew that he could never again declare them to be "guilty." 

![Image 22: A person wearing a blue dress with trailing effects behind them in a rainy setting](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/04/09/237301566/e00976a48b070bd08874a4b055a1eae9_2421534148313193330.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

In the beginning, Neuvillette was uninterested in the humans' existence, but after five centuries alongside them, he became quite fascinated with the joys and sorrows of humanity and even attempted to feel as they feel. When Focalors said goodbye to the Hydro Dragon, the Oratrice Mecanique d'Analyse Cardinale carried out the sentence, destroying the throne of Hydro Archon, killing Focalors, and returning full authority to the Dragon Sovereign. After gaining his full power, Neuvillette cleansed the Fontainians of their original sin and turned them into real people, saving them from the flood.

![Image 23: Tartaglia in his Foul Legacy Transformation from Genshin Impact, from the waist up](https://act-upload.hoyoverse.com/event-ugc-hoyowiki/2024/04/09/237301566/610d1ce3d05a0bf14311b050c06efc04_2581014749507867284.png?x-oss-process=image%2Fformat%2Cwebp)

Shortly before the prophecy began to come true, the Oratrice declared the Eleventh Fatui Harbinger, Tartaglia, guilty in the case of serial disappearances and dissolution of the people, which have been happening in Fontaine for the last 20 years. People saw this dissolution as a sign of the fulfillment of the prophecy, on par with the rising of the waters of the Primordial Sea, which caused Fontainians to dissolve. Although Childe wasn't the root cause of the disaster, the Oratrice saw him as a part of the whole scene: when Tartaglia was 14, he fell into a bottomless crack in the earth's surface. There, by chance, he awakened the All-Devouring Narwhal — a mysterious and gargantuan creature from another world, that wanted to absorb the Primordial Sea and caused the flood promised by the prophecy. According to Neuvillette, this judgment could be passed due to the liability by association, or Focalors could deliberately use Tartaglia to buy time on the assumption that the Narwhal could be held off.
Following the death of Focalors, Furina was freed from the curse and became an ordinary human. Although people blame her for not solving the prophecy, she could finally be herself and not play the role of the Hydro Archon.

**Related Entries:**

![Image 24: Black and white circular symbol of three interlocked loops surrounding a small, central circle](https://wiki.hoyolab.com/_nuxt/img/genshin_avatar_bg.d444ebd.png)![Image 25: Blue gradient graphic of a cartoon piggy bank with a graduation hat on](https://wiki.hoyolab.com/_nuxt/img/avatar.7663739.png)

Furina

![Image 26: Black and white circular symbol of three interlocked loops surrounding a small, central circle](https://wiki.hoyolab.com/_nuxt/img/genshin_avatar_bg.d444ebd.png)![Image 27: Blue gradient graphic of a cartoon piggy bank with a graduation hat on](https://wiki.hoyolab.com/_nuxt/img/avatar.7663739.png)

Neuvillette

![Image 28: Black and white circular symbol of three interlocked loops surrounding a small, central circle](https://wiki.hoyolab.com/_nuxt/img/genshin_avatar_bg.d444ebd.png)![Image 29: Blue gradient graphic of a cartoon piggy bank with a graduation hat on](https://wiki.hoyolab.com/_nuxt/img/avatar.7663739.png)

Tartaglia

![Image 30: Black and white circular symbol of three interlocked loops surrounding a small, central circle](https://wiki.hoyolab.com/_nuxt/img/genshin_avatar_bg.d444ebd.png)![Image 31: Blue gradient graphic of a cartoon piggy bank with a graduation hat on](https://wiki.hoyolab.com/_nuxt/img/avatar.7663739.png)

Marcel

![Image 32: Black and white circular symbol of three interlocked loops surrounding a small, central circle](https://wiki.hoyolab.com/_nuxt/img/genshin_avatar_bg.d444ebd.png)![Image 33: Blue gradient graphic of a cartoon piggy bank with a graduation hat on](https://wiki.hoyolab.com/_nuxt/img/avatar.7663739.png)

All-Devouring Narwhal

Mentions

![Image 34: Black and white circular symbol of three interlocked loops surrounding a small, central circle](https://wiki.hoyolab.com/_nuxt/img/genshin_avatar_bg.d444ebd.png)![Image 35: Blue gradient graphic of a cartoon piggy bank with a graduation hat on](https://wiki.hoyolab.com/_nuxt/img/avatar.7663739.png)

Neuvillette
### **Character Story**

**Character Story 4**

Neuvillette has always favored rainy days over sunny ones, as the moisture-laden air helps him relax. However, it has been a long time since he last delighted in standing under the rain.

It seems that from the time he chose to walk alongside Fontaine, he began to play the role of a strictly law-abiding normal person. Of course, normal people would not walk through the rain without an umbrella, allowing the rain to drench their hair.

It is worth mentioning that the role of Chief Justice is as much his true self as the Hydro Dragon is his essence. Only the role of "normal human" is one he must play.

It was in their solitude and guilt that humans invented a god to judge them, and in their greed and guilt that they created a god to save them. And with that god no longer present, it falls to Neuvillette to fulfill such expectations.

He has pardoned humanity, and has regained his original form.

Now, he can finally walk in the rain and enjoy it.

Indeed, he did do exactly this, and standing in the rain, he gazed into the distance, reminiscing about that day, so long ago, when he had received that letter.

Yes, a letter had found its way to him by some unknown means. The name of the recipient had been left blank, with the text only addressing him bluntly as "you."

A special you. A unique you. Neuvillette was not opposed to such a manner, but neither did he approve of it. He felt, vaguely, that the powers-that-be of the present world had no real right to judge him so.

He knew that this letter had been written by the Archon Focalors, who was inviting him to come and see Fontaine, claiming "I shall leave you a seat with the best view in the greatest theater."

Later, he would indeed come to receive that very seat — in the middle of the front row of the Opera Epiclese on the island known as Erinnyes. He would watch all manner of performances there, and the view was indeed excellent, just as Focalors had claimed.

What happened later was not made public knowledge. In all likelihood, the people had no way of understanding what it meant that the throne was shattered, or how the power of water was fully restored to its original owner. As to their being pardoned, and why they had to be forgiven in the first place, that was an even broader and more complex tale.

And thus did the curtain fall — Fontaine witnessed a happy ending to the greatest drama in history.

Or was it? A happy ending, that is. It was then that Neuvillette understood that the "seat" mentioned in the letter was not merely a chair in an opera house.

Focalors — or Furina, he should say — had given up her seat in the audience, come onstage alone, and become the heroine of the drama.

There were only ever a fixed number of seats, and for one to sit down, was for another to depart. That letter had been an invitation, issued several centuries in advance.

Well, Hydro Dragon? How do you feel about becoming a member of the human audience?

Are you enjoying this human drama?
